pages.title: Start a sleep
pages.lead: Time a nap or a night. You and Jen both see it, live.

cols.caption: Tap **Log a moment**.
Tick **Sleep** on the new blank card.
cols.note: Already ticked a feed or nappy on that card? Sleep starts its own new card.

cols.title: What it does
bullets: Times a nap or a night, start to finish.
Jen sees it on her phone, live, and can pause or stop it too.
Started late, stopped too soon, or a mistake? That's all covered in this guide.

cols.caption: The timer runs. Lock your phone if you like: it stays right.
On Log, the **Last sleep** tile adds a **Sleeping now** pill with the time asleep so far.
cols.note: The numbers above the pill stay on the last sleep that finished.

pages.title: Pause, resume, stop
pages.lead: Stop works at any time. Pause needs a minute of sleep first.

cols.note: The timer holds while baby is awake.

cols.caption: Saved. Tap **2 pauses** to see each one. Wrong time? Tap **Edit times**. Don't want it? Tap **×**, or tick it in Edit to delete several.

cols.title: Good to know
bullets: Only time asleep counts, not time awake while paused.
Paused for 2 hours? It closes itself at the time baby woke. Went back to sleep? **Edit times**.
**Stop** for the day or the night. **Pause** for a short wake.

cols.caption: While paused, the pill reads **Paused** and keeps the time asleep so far.

pages.title: Wrong time? Edit times
pages.lead: Forgot to tap when baby dropped off, or when he woke? Fix any time on a sleep, in any state.

legend: Tap a time to change it.
**Remove pause** takes a mistaken pause out.
**+ Add a pause** for a pause you forgot to tap.
Scroll or tap the hour, the minute and AM or PM.
**Done** closes the wheel. **Clear** empties the time.
This line shows what the sleep will come to.

pages.title: Edit times: good to know
pages.lead: Nothing changes until you tap **Save times**. If something is wrong, you're told which time to fix.

cols.caption: The message says which time to fix, for example when it overlaps another sleep. Nothing is changed for you.

cols.title: Good to know
bullets: Times are 12-hour, am or pm, whatever your phone is set to.
You pick the time only. The date follows the sleep.
Nothing changes until you tap **Save times**. **Cancel** drops it.
Jen can fix it too. If she saved first, the sheet tells you, and shows her times.

cols.caption: Tap **Edit times**, set when he woke, and add the pause it missed.

pages.title: Stopped by accident?
pages.lead: A quick stop asks first. Stopped too soon, or paused by mistake? Edit times puts it right.

cols.caption: **Keep sleeping** carries on. **Stop and save** keeps it. **Discard sleep** deletes it (you can restore it).

cols.title: Stopped too soon?
bullets: Tap **Edit times**, then clear **Ended** and tap **Save times**.
The sleep runs again. No pause is made.
Works at any time, even the next day, unless another sleep got in the way.

legend: The line says he's sleeping again.

cols.caption: Tap **Remove** next to that pause. It works on a finished sleep too.
cols.note: The two stretches join. The wake time stays.

pages.title: Edit, delete, restore
pages.lead: Fix the details, or delete a sleep and bring it back within 7 days.

legend: **Edit times**: fix the start, the end and every pause.
Who's logging it. Tap the name to switch.

cols.caption: Tap **×**. You're asked first.
Tap **×** on a finished sleep too. The box names the sleep, so you know which one is going.
**Timeline**, then **Recently Deleted**, then **Restore**. Kept for 7 days.
If another sleep was logged over those times, the message says which one is in the way.
cols.note: Fix or delete that sleep, then restore again.

pages.title: Two phones, one sleep
pages.lead: You and Jen see the same sleep, live. Either of you can pause, resume or stop it.

cols.caption: Joseph started it.
Jen sees the same card and the same timer.
The first tap wins. The other phone says what happened, and its card is already up to date.

cols.title: Good to know
bullets: Times follow your phone's clock and time zone. The timer uses the server's clock, so a wrong phone clock can't throw it off.
Sleeps show in Reports (the Sleep tab), but not in Timeline yet.
On iPad, sleep cards sit above the table, and Sleep has its own column.

pages.title: Sleep in Reports
pages.lead: Open **Reports**, then tap **Sleep**. Today first, then the days before.

legend: Where baby is now: **Awake** or **Sleeping**, and for how long.
Naps so far today, added up.
Today from midnight. Dark is asleep; the black line is now.
cols.note: Below: last night and each nap, with times and lengths. A sleep still going isn't added until it's stopped.

cols.caption: **Last 7 days**, **Last 30 days**, **Monthly**, **Yearly** or **All time**. Swipe along for the rest.

legend: Tap a day to see its details here.
One row per day, newest first. Dark is asleep.
Today is paler: it's still going.
cols.note: A night shows on two rows because it crosses midnight, but it counts on the day baby woke.

cols.caption: Every day in numbers, newest first. **Night + naps = Total**. Scroll sideways for the rest.

pages.title: Averages and charts
pages.lead: These follow the range you picked.

cols.caption: Nine cards for the period you picked.
cols.note: They leave out today and any day with no night logged. **Longest unbroken sleep** is the best night, not an average.

cols.caption: Tap a bar for that day. Hatched is naps; dashed is today so far.
The longest unbroken sleep each night, and how many times baby woke.
